credit.title: Credit line
credit.noneBody: FabriLink sets a credit limit when your company is reviewed. Pay with bKash, Nagad, card or cash on delivery meanwhile.
credit.howBody: Choose “B2B credit” at checkout. FabriLink pays the mill, and you settle within your terms by bKash, Nagad or bank transfer. Paid-off and cancelled orders free up your limit.

samples.title: Sample requests
samples.emptyBuyerBody: Open any fabric roll and tap “Request a sample”.
samples.emptyFactoryBody: When a buyer asks for a sample of your fabric, it shows up here.

walletSteps.PERSONAL: Open {{wallet}} → Send Money → enter this number and the amount. Write the order number as the reference. You'll get an SMS with the transaction ID (TrxID).
walletSteps.MERCHANT: Open {{wallet}} → Payment → enter this merchant number and the amount. Write the order number as the reference. You'll get an SMS with the transaction ID (TrxID).
walletSteps.AGENT: Cash in to this {{wallet}} agent number at any agent point, then keep the transaction ID (TrxID) from the SMS.

bank.localNote: From a Bangladeshi bank: send by BEFTN, RTGS (৳5 lakh or more) or NPSB using the routing number. Put the order number in the remarks.
bank.intlNote: From abroad: send a SWIFT wire using the SWIFT code. Choose “OUR” charges so the full amount arrives, and put the order number in the payment details.

form.title: 2. After you pay, tell us the details
form.bankRefHint: The reference, UTR or transaction number on your bank receipt.
form.trxHint: It's in the {{wallet}} SMS, e.g. TrxID 9A7B3C1D2E.

pay.reviewBody: We're matching your payment with our statement. This usually takes a few hours during office time. Cutting starts once it's confirmed.
pay.awaitingOps: The buyer hasn't sent a confirmed payment yet. Don't start this order.
